source_records.title: Ability-based optimization of touchscreen interactions
source_records.fact: The approach evaluates alternative interfaces against task-specific models parameterized by individual abilities.
source_records.inference: Use targeted personal constraints and task demands rather than an average-hand universal score.
source_records.limit: Touchscreen text entry, not an Azeron/game benchmark; no clinical or speed claim for the user.

source_records.title: Independence and control of the fingers depend on direction and contraction mode
source_records.fact: The reported study used twelve participants and force tasks varying direction/contraction conditions; independence depended on those conditions and finger proximity.
source_records.inference: Finger-column conflicts are screening hypotheses; source-specific physical press directions still need testing.
source_records.limit: Abstract and record reviewed; not a rapid keypad or subject-specific comfort study.

source_records.title: Bayonetta PC official manual
source_records.locator: Printed pp5-7; p5 table visually inspected from document rendering.
source_records.fact: Alt is held lock-on; Ctrl is held walk; Shift supports directional evade. Home differs between gameplay and menus.
source_records.inference: Direct non-thumb Alt and context-qualified labels resolve consequential design/display problems.
source_records.limit: First PC game only; no sequel/adapter/effective-installation inference. Source PDF retained at publisher; no full manual distributed in public Git.

source_records.title: God of War Ragnarok accessibility
source_records.fact: The source documents hold/toggle choices for block and aim, evade styles and sprint input alternatives.
source_records.inference: Gesture/preset settings change the concurrent-input graph even when the action name is the same.
source_records.limit: Controller-oriented guide; no exact PC default key table or user-selected option established.

source_records.title: Cyberpunk controls support
source_records.fact: CDPR asks for UserSettings.json and information about input scheme when diagnosing controls.
source_records.inference: Read input configuration evidence before converting generic reference labels into effective labels.
source_records.limit: The source does not establish the complete XML schema or that one JSON contains every override.

source_records.title: Public PoE2 configuration example — format only
source_records.locator: ACTION_KEYS, WASD_ACTION_KEYS and bounded input-mode fields
source_records.fact: The file has separate action banks and different encodings for similarly named skill actions; it includes multiple mode indicators.
source_records.inference: Collector keeps banks/mode fields separate and raw flags unresolved.
source_records.limit: Not the user's file and not official defaults. Private/account/graphics values are not used as user preferences or copied into the Atlas.

source_records.title: Existing game-tools graphics controls
source_records.fact: Owner guidance reserves Delete for ReShade, Home for OptiScaler and F12 for one shared game-engine interface where supported.
source_records.inference: Bayonetta Home/Delete may conflict if those tools are actually active; collect effective state rather than silently rebind.
source_records.limit: A scoped installation default is not evidence of the live tool stack or permission to change shortcuts.
